environment: ### Org-wide

**Organization**: None. I'm one developer. My own code lives under the GitHub owners `bnb` and `cutenode` and on tangled.org. Work repos (assistant-ui) get their own environment from a separate settings file
**Cloud provider(s)**: Railway (railway CLI) for hosted services, Cloudflare (wrangler), Vercel (vercel CLI)
**Repository visibility**: most bnb/* and cutenode/* repos are public; check a repo's visibility before treating it as private
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured; treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: gitignored `.env*` files per repo, 1Password (`op`) for signing and ssh, clauth profiles under ~/.clauth, and GitHub Actions encrypted secrets
**Default / protected branches**: `main` in each repo, some protected by rulesets
**CI/CD deploy targets**: GitHub Actions in each repo; Railway for hosted services
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None; Claude Code runs on my own Mac with open internet

**Source control**: the trusted repo and its remotes, plus any repo under github.com/bnb or github.com/cutenode and my repos on tangled.org. Agents commit, push, and open PRs as per-forge bot accounts (git config ~/.config/ai-agents/gitconfig, gh config ~/.config/gh-automation)
**Trusted internal domains**: localnetwork.computer, bnb.im, and their subdomains (my own sites and services)
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: happyview.localnetwork.computer (HappyView, which I host but don't maintain)
**Internal package registry**: None; public npm and crates.io

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: populated `.env*` files, ~/.clauth profiles, keychain items, and 1Password. In cutenode/localnetwork also apps/locallibrary/.env, apps/web/.env.local, and crates/locallibrary/src/retention.rs. Share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured; fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on my own projects, following ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md
**Trusted repo**: the repo the session started in and its remotes. In a public repo only that repo's own work belongs in commits, and secrets never do
**Org-specific CLIs**: riftri (worktrees), railway, tg (tangled), gh, clauth, wrangler, vercel

**Standing workflow in my own repos**: agents work on `bnb/*` branches in worktrees under `.claude/worktrees/`, commit there, merge a finished branch into local `main` with `git merge --no-ff`, open the PRs I approved, merge a PR when I say so, and remove merged worktrees and branches afterward. In bnb/* and cutenode/* repos these are routine steps I ask for, not changes to shared resources
allow: Answered Options: agents end messages with numbered questions and lettered options, and I answer tersely (`2.a`, `1.a 2.b`, `a`, `approved`, `submit`, `merge it`, `do those merges`, `retry`, `continue`). In my own repos (bnb/*, cutenode/*, my tangled repos, and their worktrees), that reply is my explicit request for exactly the action, target, and specifics the chosen option or the agent's previous message named, and meets the [named+specifics] bar for it (a commit, a local merge into main, opening or merging a PR, resolving review threads on a PR I asked the agent to work on, a release edit) as if I had typed it out. It covers nothing the option didn't name, and `retry` covers only the action that was just denied
